behavioral_notes.observation: sale_crm wires the sale<->crm bridge with a single field: sale.order.opportunity_id (Many2one crm.lead, check_company=True, index='btree_not_null', domain type='opportunity' and same/no company). sale.order.action_confirm is overridden to call super() under a context stripped of 'default_tag_ids' (so the order's tags don't leak as crm defaults), then for each order calls order.opportunity_id._update_revenues_from_so(order): this raises the opportunity's expected_revenue to the order's amount_untaxed ONLY when the current expected_revenue is lower AND order.currency_id equals the opportunity company's currency, and logs a tracked chatter message ('Expected revenue has been updated based on the linked Sales Orders.'). Confirming a quotation therefore back-propagates revenue to the pipeline; cross-currency orders are skipped silently. None of this side-effect is visible in metadata.

The reciprocal counts on crm.lead are one compute (_compute_sale_data, @api.depends on order_ids.state/currency_id/amount_untaxed/date_order/company_id) splitting order_ids by three domain helpers: _get_lead_quotation_domain = state in (draft,sent) -> quotation_count; _get_lead_sale_order_domain = state NOT in (draft,sent,cancel) -> sale_order_count and the basis for sale_amount_total. sale_amount_total sums each confirmed order's amount_untaxed converted into the lead company_currency via currency_id._convert(date_order or today). So 'Quotations' counts open quotes while 'Orders'/'Sum of Orders' count only confirmed (non-draft/sent/cancel) orders, and amounts are FX-normalised to the lead's company currency. The stat buttons on the opportunity form bind these (action_view_sale_quotation drills to draft/sent/cancel quotes, action_view_sale_order to confirmed orders).

The opportunity form's 'New Quotation' button calls action_sale_quotations_new: if the lead has no partner_id it opens the crm.quotation.partner wizard (action sale_crm.crm_quotation_partner_action) to resolve a customer first; otherwise it calls action_new_quotation, which opens the sale_crm.sale_action_quotations_new act_window with a context built by _prepare_opportunity_quotation_context -- carrying default_opportunity_id, default_partner_id, default_origin=lead.name, UTM defaults (campaign/medium/source), default_company_id, default_tag_ids, and default_team_id/default_user_id when set. So a quotation created from an opportunity inherits the lead's customer, salesperson, team, UTM attribution and tags, and is auto-linked back via opportunity_id. The button is hidden for type=='lead' and for inactive zero-probability leads.

The transient wizard crm.quotation.partner resolves which customer a new quotation targets. default_get refuses to run unless context active_model=='crm.lead' (UserError otherwise), loads the lead, prefills partner_id from lead._find_matching_partner() (email-based match, no create) and defaults action to 'exist' when a match exists else 'create'. action_apply: for 'create' calls lead._handle_partner_assignment(create_missing=True) (creates a res.partner from lead data when none), for 'exist' forces lead._handle_partner_assignment(force_partner_id=..., create_missing=False), 'nothing' leaves the lead partner untouched; then returns lead.action_new_quotation(). NB: despite its docstring ('Convert lead to opportunity or merge lead and opportunity'), the wizard does NOT convert the lead -- it only sets/creates the lead's partner_id before launching the quotation form.

crm.lead._merge_get_fields_specific is overridden to add order_ids: lambda fname, leads: [(4, order.id) for order in leads.order_ids]. When duplicate leads/opportunities are merged (crm's _merge_opportunity), this re-parents every sale.order from the losing leads onto the surviving opportunity instead of orphaning them, so quotation/order links and the reciprocal counts follow the merge. Pure-Python merge behaviour invisible to metadata.

Two crm.team overrides retarget the Sales Teams dashboard when viewed inside the Sales app: when context 'in_sales_app' is set and the team use_opportunities, _compute_dashboard_button_name relabels dashboard_button_name to 'Sales Analysis', and action_primary_channel_button returns the sale.action_order_report_so_salesteam report action instead of the CRM pipeline action. So the same crm.team kanban card opens the CRM forecast from CRM but the sales-order analysis from Sales -- a context-sensitive UI redirect, not a data change.

No JS/OWL: 0 js files, 0 xml templates, 0 OWL components, 0 registry adds/patches, no asset bundles. The module is entirely backend/ORM plus static XML view inheritance (the 'New Quotation' button and Quotations/Orders stat buttons on crm.lead_view_form, opportunity_id on sale.view_order_form, a 'My Quotations' menu under the CRM app). data/crm_lead_merge_template.xml supplies the merge mail template.

it_architecture.application: sale_crm (sale<->crm bridge: quotations from opportunities and revenue/pipeline feedback)
logical_data_erm: crm.lead -> sale.order (order_ids, One2many inverse of opportunity_id)
information_flows: side-effect: crm.lead.action_sale_quotations_new -> crm.quotation.partner wizard (when no partner) -> action_new_quotation -> sale.order prefilled from lead (partner, UTM, team, user, tags, origin)
side-effect: sale.order.action_confirm -> crm.lead._update_revenues_from_so -> opportunity expected_revenue raised + chatter log
side-effect: crm.lead._compute_sale_data -> quotation_count / sale_order_count / sale_amount_total (FX-normalised) on the opportunity
side-effect: crm.lead merge -> _merge_get_fields_specific re-parents order_ids to the surviving opportunity
ui-flow: crm.team dashboard in Sales app -> Sales Analysis (sale.action_order_report_so_salesteam) via in_sales_app context

capabilities: Create a quotation from an opportunity (prefilled customer/UTM/team/salesperson/tags)
Resolve or create the quotation customer from lead data
Link sale orders back to their source opportunity
Roll up quotation count, order count and confirmed-order revenue onto the opportunity
Feed back confirmed-order revenue into the opportunity's expected revenue
Preserve order links when opportunities are merged
Retarget the Sales Team dashboard to sales-order analysis inside the Sales app
value_streams: Opportunity-to-Quotation: qualified opportunity -> New Quotation -> partner resolution wizard -> sale.order created with opportunity_id + lead context
Quote-to-Pipeline feedback: sale.order.action_confirm -> expected_revenue update + sale_amount_total / sale_order_count refresh on the opportunity
organization: sales_team.group_sale_salesman (controls opportunity_id visibility on the sale order form)
policies: Quotations counted in draft/sent; orders counted only when confirmed (not draft/sent/cancel)
expected_revenue only raised (never lowered) and only when order currency matches the company currency
New Quotation button hidden for leads (type=='lead') and inactive zero-probability opportunities
Quotation tags excluded from CRM defaults on confirm (default_tag_ids stripped)
Merging opportunities re-parents linked sale orders rather than orphaning them

classification.apqc_category: 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services
classification.rationale: sale_crm is a primary value-chain bridge: it sits at the Marketing-and-Sell -> Sell handoff, turning a qualified crm opportunity into a sale.order quotation and feeding the resulting confirmed-order revenue back into the pipeline. Its substance is the order document linkage (opportunity_id) plus action_confirm -> expected_revenue feedback and the reciprocal quote/order counts -- i.e. it advances the linear quote-to-cash chain rather than running a recursive diagnose/qualify loop (that is crm's own value-shop concern, classified separately) or maintaining firm infrastructure (support). It is a primary activity feeding APQC 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services (the sell / manage-sales-orders process groups, 3.5 sales-order leg specifically, with the New-Quotation-from-opportunity bridging 3.4/3.5). 9.0 Financial was rejected: although action_confirm touches revenue, it updates a CRM forecast figure (expected_revenue), not a financial ledger. The bridge inherits the value model of its sale side (chain), while the crm side it connects to is the value-shop -- the join point itself is chain/primary because it operates on and progresses the sales order.
classification.rationale_apqc_number: 3.0 number matches name 'Market and Sell Products and Services' (not 9.0 Financial / not 13.0 master-data).

standard_capabilities: 'New Quotation' action on the opportunity form (with customer-resolution wizard)
sale.order <-> crm.lead linkage (opportunity_id / order_ids) with auto-prefill of customer, UTM, team, salesperson and tags
Quotations / Orders stat buttons and 'Sum of Orders' on the opportunity, drilling into the related orders
Confirmed-order revenue feedback into opportunity expected_revenue
Order links preserved across opportunity merges
Context-sensitive Sales Team dashboard (Sales Analysis report inside the Sales app)
'My Quotations' menu surfaced in the CRM app
typical_fits: Sell from the pipeline: quote directly off a qualified opportunity and keep the order traceable to its source lead
Forecast accuracy: confirmed orders auto-update the opportunity's expected revenue and stat counters
Same salesperson/team/UTM carried from opportunity to quotation for clean attribution
Deduplicate opportunities without losing their quotations/orders
common_gaps: expected_revenue is only ever raised and only for same-currency orders -- multi-currency pipelines or downward revisions need customisation
No automatic stage advance / won-marking when a linked order is confirmed (the order link does not move the opportunity through the pipeline)
sale_amount_total / counts are non-stored computes -- reporting that needs stored or historical snapshots requires extra fields
Customer resolution is email-match only (lead._find_matching_partner) -- richer matching (VAT, phone) is not built in
No portal/website quotation-from-lead flow (backend opportunity form only; gap #3 empty)
